# T-4: Skip absent regression

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Change final-regression so absence of a project regression command can be recorded as skipped_by_project_policy instead of invalid_project_test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- no supported project regression command source fixture produces result=skipped and skipKind=skipped_by_project_policy.
- malformed configured command and invalid discovery fixtures remain invalid_project_test failures.
- skipped_by_project_policy artifact includes proof.commandDiscovery with checkedSources, supportedCommandFound=false, invalidConfiguredCommand=false, and reason.
- process metadata has started=false, null exitCode/signal/spawnError, timedOut=false.
- existing command failures remain fail artifacts and do not become skipped.

## Implementation Notes
Keep raw attempt log creation for skipped artifacts. Restrict skipped_by_project_policy to true absence of supported command sources, not command execution failure or malformed configured command. Add a proof class/validator branch for skipped_by_project_policy rather than exempting it from proof validation.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for final-regression command discovery absence, execution failure, and validator behavior.
